mapper.update: UPDATE blog b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT blog_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM like_blog GROUP BY blog_id ) l ON l.blog_id = b.id SET b.like_count = COALESCE(l.like_count, 0) WHERE b.like_count != COALESCE(l.like_count, 0)

UPDATE `comment` c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM like_comment GROUP BY comment_id ) l ON l.comment_id = c.id SET c.like_count = COALESCE(l.like_count, 0) WHERE c.like_count != COALESCE(l.like_count, 0)
